data_custody.export: full vector and marginal errors only; paired block vectors discarded
data_custody.separate_set_independence: declared statistical sampling assumption, not inferred from marginal errors
data_custody.source_pairing: y peak and every T peak evaluated on the same deleted blocks within each run set

comparison_budget.scope: Sharp PSD delta-method variance ranges conditional on supplied marginal estimates and serialized numerical influence coefficients; no nonlinear or coverage bound

comparison_not_blind.uncertainty_scope: A unique statistical SD is unidentified; the reduction allowance has no calibrated probabilistic coverage. No combined significance is assigned.

continuum_extrapolation.form: value = continuum + C / beta_G + D(physical size); largest size is the reference

endpoint.note: m_H_at_x: Higgs mass at which the declared chain reaches x on its transition line; None where the map has no such mass. m_H_tree_at_x: tree level, x = m_H^2 / (8 m_W^2).

finite_size_cutoff.scope: Finite design sensitivity; no bound on missing higher cutoff powers or infinite volume.

higgs_mass_scan_declared_chain.note: other inputs of the declared chain fixed; peak position at beta_G = 8 without continuum extrapolation

hypercharge_field_estimate.note: difference of the peak position in y at beta_G = 8 between the published simulation with the U(1) field (z = 0.31) and this simulation (z = 0); read from figures, accuracy about 0.003 in y
